Name: BOSS Audio - ELITE 1600W Class AB Bridgeable 2-Channel MOSFET Amplifier with Variable Low-Pass Crossover - Black
Natural: Breathe life into your music with this BOSS Audio Elite amplifier. The 1600W maximum power output and MOSFET power supply ensure clean and quality sound, while specific linear circuitry minimizes distortion. A thermal protection circuit turns off the amplifier if it gets too hot. This BOSS Audio Elite amplifier has high-level and low-level inputs for building an audio system using the standard factory unit.
